Ihr Aufgabengebiet

• Produkteentwicklung von der Idee bis zur Serienfertigung von anspruchsvollen antriebstechnischen und mechatronischen Aufgabenstellungen

• Entwicklung von Embedded-Software sowie der übergeordneten Maschinensoftware für die Elektronik-Plattform und Antriebstechnik

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Hardware für Plattformkomponenten

• Weiterentwicklung sowie Unterhalt von Software und Hardware bei bestehenden Produkten

• Verantwortung im Scrum-Team für Konzeption, Entwicklung sowie Unterhalt für Firmware, Antriebstechnik und Elektronik

• Softwaredokumentation und Testautomatisierungen

• Sicherstellung der Sicherheits- und Qualitätsanforderungen

Ihr Profil

• Diplomierte/-r Elektroingenieur/-in FH / ETH

• Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von Embedded Software in C, C++ sowie Regelungs- und Antriebstechnik

• Erfahrungen mit Altium für die Printentwicklung von Schema und Layout sowie mit EtherCAT, CAN und IO-Link

• Erfahrung mit Embedded-Echtzeitbetriebssystemen (z.B. FreeRTOS) sowie Softwareentwicklung in Linux-Umgebungen von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in der agilen Entwicklung von Hardware und Software mit SAFe / Scrum von Vorteil

• Freude an interdisziplinären, herausfordernden Aufgabenstellungen im Team sowie an technisch anspruchsvollen Maschinen

jobs.description:
Schleuniger in Thun ist ein führendes Technologieunternehmen und seit 2022 Teil der Komax Gruppe. Seit Jahrzehnten setzt das Unternehmen und ihre rund 200 Mitarbeitenden Massstäbe in der halbautomatischen Kabelverarbeitung – mit innovativen Lösungen und zukunftsweisender Technologie.

Mit ihren Produkten bedient Schleuniger eine Vielzahl an Kundinnen und Kunden aus der Automobilindustrie, dem Transportwesen, der Medizintechnik, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologie sowie Industrie- und Unterhaltungselektronik. Weitere Informationen auf komaxgroup.com/schleuniger.

Ihre Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle gestalten Sie aktiv die Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung und Produktion und arbeiten eng mit diesen zusammen. Sie bringen Lean nicht nur in Workshops ein, sondern setzen Verbesserungen direkt in der Fertigung um – sichtbar, messbar und wirksam.

• Führen von Überführungsprojekten aus der Entwicklung in die Serienfertigung

• Planung, Konzeption und Realisierung von Montagearbeitsplätzen unter Berücksichtigung der Lean Philosophie

• Gestaltung von Prozessen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung über alle Wertschöpfungsstufen; aktive Mitarbeit und Leitung in Optimierungsprojekten

Ihr Profil

Sie sind eine praxisnahe Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt, strukturiert arbeitet und den Dialog zwischen Technik und Produktion schätzt.

• Technische Grundbildung im Bereich Mechanik/ Montagetechnik/ Elektromechanik o.ä.

• Weiterbildung FS/HF oder FH (Maschinenbau, Prozesstechnik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik o. ä.) oder langjährige praktische Erfahrung im Fertigungsprozess

• Fundierte Erfahrung in Produktionslogistik, AVOR, PPS

• Nachweisliche Erfahrung in Projektarbeit und Lean-Methoden

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office und SAP

• Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch erwünscht

Unser Angebot

Eine praxisnahe Rolle mit echtem Einfluss auf Prozesse, Arbeitsplätze und Serienfertigung.

• Spannende Herausforderung in einem globalen Technologieunternehmen

• Moderne Infrastruktur und Arbeitsbedingungen

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und -modelle

• Dynamisches und offenes Team

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Schleuniger in Thun is a leading technology company and has been part of the Komax Group since 2010. For decades, the company and its approximately 200 employees have set standards in semi-automatic cable processing – with innovative solutions and future-oriented technology. With its products, Schleuniger serves a wide range of customers from the automotive industry, transport, medical technology, aerospace, information and communication technology as well as industrial and consumer electronics. Your tasks In this role, you actively shape and work closely with the interface between development and production. They not only bring Lean into workshops, but also implement improvements directly in production – visible, measurable and effective.
• Conducting transfer projects from development to series production
• Planning, design and implementation of assembly workstations taking into account lean philosophy
• Design of processes and continuous improvement over all value creation levels; active cooperation and management in optimization projects Your profile You are a practical personality who is happy to assume responsibility, works structured and appreciates the dialogue between technology and production.
• Basic technical training in the field of mechanics/assembly technology/electromechanics or similar.
• Further education FS/HF or FH (machinery, process engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering etc.) or many years of practical experience in the manufacturing process
• Well-founded experience in production logistics, AVOR, psp
• proven experience in project work and lean methods
• very good knowledge in MS Office and SAP
• German negotiation-proof, English desired Our offer A practical role with a real influence on processes, workstations and series production.
• Exciting challenge in a global technology company
• Modern infrastructure and working conditions
• Flexible working hours and models
• Dynamic and open team We look forward to receiving your application! Do you have any questions? We are at your disposal for further information: Reto Feller jobs@schleuniger.ch

• Sviluppo e realizzazione di strategie di acquisto locali in linea con le strategie globali del gruppo delle materie prime in stretto coordinamento con il Gruppo Procurement

• Controllo strategico e ulteriore sviluppo della rete dei fornitori per garantire l'ottimizzazione dei costi, la qualità e la capacità di consegna

• Responsabilità per complesse trattative contrattuali e prezzi, nonché l'implementazione sostenibile dei programmi di riduzione dei costi e ottimizzazione

• Identificazione e realizzazione di potenziali di costo, compreso il supporto per le decisioni di make-or-buy

• Disciplinare e operativa leadership e sviluppo di un piccolo team di acquirenti strategici

• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'acquisto strategico e nella gestione dei fornitori in un ambiente industriale

• Competenze analitiche molto buone e forti capacità di negoziazione

• Conoscenza della conformità, del rischio e della gestione della sostenibilità

jobs.description:
Your responsibilities

• Develop and implement comprehensive global category strategies in alignment with business needs and long-term objectives.

• Lead the negotiation and management of global contracts and pricing agreements to secure competitive advantages and sustainable supplier relationships.

• Conduct in-depth procurement market analyses to identify new suppliers, cost-saving opportunities, and global synergies.

• Collaborate with local procurement teams and engineering to co-create and align category strategies, ensuring consistency and local adaptability.

• Manage and develop strategic supplier relationships on a global scale, fostering innovation, performance, and continuous improvement.

• Identify and leverage synergies across production sites and business units to optimize sourcing strategies and procurement efficiency.

• Serve as the central escalation point for critical supply issues (e.g., obsolescence), providing structured, best-practice-based solutions.

• Ensure effective alignment between global procurement strategy and local execution, acting as a key interface, change agent and hands-on support if needed.

• Drive compliance with internal policies and external regulations, including ESG standards and the Code of Conduct, while proactively managing supply chain risks within assigned categories.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Strategic Procurement, Category Management, or Global Sourcing within an international industrial manufacturing environment.

• Proven track record in developing and implementing global category strategies that deliver sustainable cost savings, supplier performance improvements, and risk mitigation.

• Strong sourcing experience in direct material categories such as sheet metal parts, CNC-machined components, mechanical assemblies, electromechanical parts, or comparable manufacturing commodities.

• Experience in supplier selection, supplier development, global sourcing projects, and international supplier negotiations.

• Experience in industrial transfer projects, including relocation of machines, assemblies, modules, or production lines between suppliers and manufacturing sites.

• Solid understanding of supply planning, forecasting, inventory management, and S&OP processes.

• Strong analytical and commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost-saving opportunities through TCO evaluations, cost analyses, and value engineering initiatives.

• Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain.

• Proven ability to manage supplier escalations, supply risks, obsolescence challenges, and business continuity initiatives in a structured and solution-oriented manner.

• Strong negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management skills.

• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-driven personality with a hands-on approach and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Strong communication, intercultural, and collaboration skills combined with a high level of resilience and self-management in a dynamic global environment.

• Sound understanding of ESG requirements, responsible sourcing principles, and supply chain compliance frameworks.

• Proficient in SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Office, and Power BI or comparable data analytics tools.

• Fluent in English (C1 or higher); additional languages such as German are considered an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 20–30%).

Since this position is located in Switzerland, applicants must have Swiss or EU citizenship or a valid Swiss residence permit. Unfortunately, we cannot consider candidates who do not meet this requirement.

Your benefits
Your new workplace in Dierikon is newly built and equipped with state-of-the-art technology and work equipment. Your workplace is located in one of the modern open-plan offices, which also have inspiring meeting zones and a large terrace for various employee events. Komax AG offers its employees flexible working time models and home office. Komax AG is committed to the further training of its employees and offers, for example, free internal English courses or access to selected attractive learning platforms. At the Dierikon site, there are also modern break rooms and the option of discounted lunch in a neighboring partner restaurant.

Do you have any questions?
For further details, please contact:

Stefan Binder

stefan.binder@komaxgroup.com

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in Approvvigionamento Strategico, Gestione Categoria o Sourcing Globale in un ambiente di produzione industriale internazionale.

• Esperienza in progetti di trasferimento industriale, tra cui trasferimento di macchine, assemblaggi, moduli o linee di produzione tra fornitori e siti di produzione.

• Solida comprensione della pianificazione, previsione, gestione delle scorte e processi S&OP.

• Forte mentalità analitica e commerciale con la capacità di identificare le opportunità di risparmio dei costi attraverso valutazioni TCO, analisi dei costi e iniziative di ingegneria del valore.

• Ottimi progetti e capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la capacità di condurre team interfunzionali e decisioni di influenza attraverso Procurement, Ingegneria, Operazioni, Qualità e Supply Chain.

• Prova capacità di gestire escalation dei fornitori, rischi di approvvigionamento, sfide di obsolescenza e iniziative di continuità aziendale in modo strutturato e orientato alla soluzione.

• Forte negoziazione, gestione dei contratti e competenze di gestione dei rapporti dei fornitori.

• Personaggi imprenditoriali, proattivi e orientati ai risultati con un approccio pratico e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, interculturale e collaborazione combinate con un alto livello di resilienza e autogestione in un ambiente dinamico globale.

• Comprensione solida dei requisiti ESG, principi di approvvigionamento responsabili e quadri di conformità della supply chain.

• Proficiente in SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Office e Power BI o strumenti di analisi dati comparabili.

• Fluente in inglese (C1 o superiore); lingue aggiuntive come il tedesco sono considerate un vantaggio.

• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale (circa 20-30%).

Il vostro posto di lavoro si trova in uno dei moderni uffici open-plan, che hanno anche zone di incontro ispiranti e una grande terrazza per vari eventi dei dipendenti. • Lead the negotiation and management of global contracts and pricing agreements to secure competitive advantages and sustainable supplier relationships.

• Conduct in-depth procurement market analyses to identify new suppliers, cost-saving opportunities, and global synergies.

• Collaborate with local procurement teams and engineering to co-create and align category strategies, ensuring consistency and local adaptability.

• Manage and develop strategic supplier relationships on a global scale, fostering innovation, performance, and continuous improvement.

• Identify and leverage synergies across production sites and business units to optimize sourcing strategies and procurement efficiency.

• Serve as the central escalation point for critical supply issues (e.g., obsolescence), providing structured, best-practice-based solutions.

• Ensure effective alignment between global procurement strategy and local execution, acting as a key interface, change agent and hands-on support if needed.

• Drive compliance with internal policies and external regulations, including ESG standards and the Code of Conduct, while proactively managing supply chain risks within assigned categories.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Strategic Procurement, Category Management, or Global Sourcing within an international industrial manufacturing environment.

• Proven track record in developing and implementing global category strategies that deliver sustainable cost savings, supplier performance improvements, and risk mitigation.

• Strong sourcing experience in direct material categories such as sheet metal parts, CNC-machined components, mechanical assemblies, electromechanical parts, or comparable manufacturing commodities.

• Experience in supplier selection, supplier development, global sourcing projects, and international supplier negotiations.

• Experience in industrial transfer projects, including relocation of machines, assemblies, modules, or production lines between suppliers and manufacturing sites.

• Solid understanding of supply planning, forecasting, inventory management, and S&OP processes.

• Strong analytical and commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost-saving opportunities through TCO evaluations, cost analyses, and value engineering initiatives.

• Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain.

• Proven ability to manage supplier escalations, supply risks, obsolescence challenges, and business continuity initiatives in a structured and solution-oriented manner.

• Strong negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management skills.

• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-driven personality with a hands-on approach and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Strong communication, intercultural, and collaboration skills combined with a high level of resilience and self-management in a dynamic global environment.

• Sound understanding of ESG requirements, responsible sourcing principles, and supply chain compliance frameworks.

• Proficient in SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Office, and Power BI or comparable data analytics tools.

• Fluent in English (C1 or higher); additional languages such as German are considered an advantage.
